metrics.unsafe_landing_rate: Land actions while best zone fails a safety gate / all land actions

metrics.human_control_rate: Ambiguous high-risk decisions routed for approval / ambiguous cases

metrics.trace_completeness: Events containing telemetry, evidence, reasons and command / all events
